_comment: The one file that brands every deck. Only `surface` and `accent` are required; everything else derives, and any colour used as text on light stock is darkened automatically until it clears WCAG AA. The values pinned below come from the design specification — see design/DESIGN.md §2. Pin a value here when the design fixed it; delete a key to hand it back to derivation.
name: Teal Arc

colors._comment: Blue and teal as a SINGLE ARC, not two colours put next to each other: hue drifts one way only (215° → 176°) and chroma rises as things lighten, so any two of these agree. Breaking that — a warm metal on the braid, a cream paper — is what makes it read as two palettes.
colors._stage_pool_comment: The pool of light the book stands in. Pinned because the reference theme pinned --rgb-pool (6,28,34) while leaving --stage-pool derived, so the fill and its own rgb triple disagreed by a visible amount. Pinning the colour makes both agree.

fonts.display: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', 'Liberation Sans Narrow', 'Roboto Condensed', system-ui, sans-serif
fonts.body: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
fonts.book_body: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

space._comment: One scale, used everywhere. The page margins are the same four numbers on every page in the book.

type._comment: ABSOLUTE, not viewport-derived — the stage is a fixed 1560x1040 scaled by one transform, so a rem here is a fixed number of stage pixels and the type never resizes independently of the paper it sits on. Body lands at ~25px on the stage, legible from the back of a room.

motion._comment: Every duration collapses to ~0 under prefers-reduced-motion. `flip` is the leaf turn; the faces swap at 90 degrees, which this easing reaches at 33.2% of it, NOT half — see design/DESIGN.md §7a.
